facts.business: Gillanders Arbuthnot and Company Limited operates in four business groups: Textile, Tea, Engineering (MICCO), and Property.

capacity_or_capex.item: Solar power plant at Arun Tea Estate (401.36 kWp)
capacity_or_capex.timeline: likely to be commissioned in the current year

guidance_or_targets.statement: Engineering Division maintains a positive outlook for the current year backed by robust order bookings and growing opportunities from expansion/upgradation of steel industry.
Tea Division expects stable performance during the current year.
Overall outlook for the synthetic value chain in the current year remains challenging owing to continued uncertainties from West Asia Crisis and persistent subdued demand.

key_risks: Geopolitical developments such as US tariffs and West Asia crisis impacting textile exports and input costs
Volatility and uncertainty in global trade due to ongoing geopolitical situations
Dependence on export markets with longer credit periods
facts.related_party_note: Inter-segment transfers are based on prevailing market prices. The Company is not reliant on revenues from transactions with any external customer for more than 10% of its revenue.
